8.37.9.2. iLock_Geography.switch_types.DirObj2NodeTypePaths.endObjectCondition¶

DirObj2NodeTypePaths.endObjectCondition(obj, endInIndex)¶

Determine if an object together with the index of the node containing that object satisfies certain conditions. These conditions include:

  • whether the type of the object is in the user provided types,
  • whether the object and the index satisfy the user provided condition endCondition.
  • whether the object is facing or trailing.

This function is used by isEndNodeIndex to determine if a node index is an end node index.

Parameters:
  • obj (IRailyardComponent) – The obj to consider
  • endInIndex (int) – The index of the node containing obj.
Return type:

bool
Returns:

Return True if obj with endInIndex satisfy the specified conditions.
